---
title: "Homework"
---

The homework is a Quarto document, `homework.qmd`,
in the top folder of the course repository.
You'll write your code and your answers in that file,
render it,
and hand it in on Canvas.
The due date is on Canvas.

To read through the homework before you start,
[view `homework.qmd` on GitHub](https://github.com/chendaniely/MEDI-504A-2026W1-biostats/blob/main/homework.qmd).

## 1. Open your fork

You'll work in the fork of the course repository you made in the lab,
either in a Codespace or on your own computer.
If you don't have a fork yet,
follow [Clone the repository](lecture-02/01-clone-the-repo.qmd) first.

## 2. Get the homework into your fork

If your fork doesn't have a `homework.qmd` file in its top folder,
your fork was made before the homework was added.
To bring it up to date:

1. On your fork's page on GitHub,
   click **Sync fork**, then **Update branch**.
2. In your Codespace or on your computer,
   open a terminal in the repository and run `git pull`.

## 3. Open the homework file

Open `homework.qmd`
(not this website's own `homework-instructions.qmd` file next to it)
and follow the instructions at the top of the file.
Every question has a hint,
and the hints are written so you can paste them into Copilot Chat as your prompt.
